conditions.host: Dedicated Forge server with jem_security enabled and the matching required client companion

change.summary: Add server-authoritative Creative provenance, command and game-mode audit, outgoing-chunk Anti-Xray, action validation and bounded client attestation

modifiers.before: The initial chunk packet exposes every real ore block state to resource packs and client render mods
modifiers.after: Fully enclosed forge:ores blocks and Ancient Debris are encoded as a neighboring solid filler until server-observed exposure, without changing the authoritative world block
modifiers.notes: Exposed ores remain visible. The server reveals adjacent real states after block removal

modifiers.before: No JEM-owned durable correlation between a Creative slot mutation and the later stack
modifiers.after: Creative-created stacks receive a provenance UUID and per-player JSONL transitions cover creation, clearing, count reduction, inventory exit, drop, pickup, use, placement and container closure through one bounded daemon writer that never blocks the game thread

modifiers.before: No matching JEM security channel or bounded declared-mod/resource-pack report
modifiers.after: Matching client/server protocol is required; exact configured banned mod IDs and suspicious enabled pack tokens are rejected while jem_freecam remains allowed
An operator may request a bounded sanitized latest.log tail, but transmission starts only after an explicit player click and removes user paths, likely secrets and IP addresses

rationale.purpose: Prevent hidden-ore disclosure and unauthorized remote interactions while preserving auditable Creative administration without FCW AntiCheat render integration
rationale.user_requested: Create JEM Security, keep test jem unchanged, allow JEM Freecam, block third-party through-block freecam and xray advantages, and track Creative and suspicious actions
rationale.codex_choices: Use outgoing chunk encoding instead of renderer hooks, exact configurable client IDs plus server authority, provenance NBT for Creative stacks, JSONL journals and consent-only sanitized log transfer

introduced.summary: Add the standalone source and production artifact without installing it into test jem or runtime distributions

history.summary: Add server-authoritative audit, Anti-Xray and matching client attestation while explicitly allowing jem_freecam

relations: Authoritative LevelChunk -> filtered outgoing section copy -> client chunk only
Creative slot packet -> provenance tag -> server transition journal
Declared client mods and packs -> bounded attestation -> exact configured admission decision
Administrator request -> player consent -> client-side redaction -> bounded server file
notes: JEM Freecam remains allowed and retains its own collision and interaction guards
No Embeddium, Oculus or renderer class is referenced
The module is inactive on integrated servers
Client attestation is forgeable and is never treated as sole proof
unresolved: Runtime Mixin application, modded ore-tag coverage, handshake behavior and player acceptance are unobserved because no game or server launch was authorized
Unknown or deliberately renamed client mods and resource packs cannot be identified reliably from a hostile client
The production JAR is not installed in Client/ManagedPack, test jem or the ordinary local Server by explicit user request
